title: meta.json
description: The meta of one template: its purpose, who may send it to whom, what it needs from the receiver, and the kinds of its replies. The stream checks from, to and replies at post time.

type.description: The kind. It must be the same as the folder name.

purpose.description: One sentence: when a sender uses this kind.

from.description: The party classes that may send it.

to.description: The party classes that may get it.

needs.description: What the receiver must do. A value makes an inbox card.

replies.description: The kinds that may reply to it (refs.reply).

turn.description: An added kind only: a receiver session gets the message as a turn. Default: true when "to" allows a session. The core kinds have fixed rules in code.

card.description: The two actions of the inbox card.

parties.description: "*" is all parties. Other values: user, session, supervisor, docs, policy, or another party name.

post.description: The kind that the action posts.

text.description: The field whose value is the text of the post.

needsText.description: The action opens the answer sheet first.
